title: Aid-Only last-feed cattle-alarm skip does not match play
body:
Duplicate of 3c7025775acf25b7: the 2026-09-02 Grok-4.6 stress wave re-observed the same Aid-Only last-feed mismatch with fresher evidence, so the defect is tracked there. This record keeps the 2026-08-31 wave (21 S2 reports) attached to Linear MIC-56.

Aid-Only / limited-duty ready-made setup copy says the **last feed skips the +1 cattle-alarm bump**. After a failed first LURE LAY, the last CAST still raises cattle alarm (often 3→4 Breaking) and the scattered-cattle ending uses that band.

This 200-player grok-4.6 (low) MCP wave (build `36ff6d106fa0df2ff19e80d09cf00df081b81653`, seed-base `1900000000`, store `ai-runs/playtest/grok-wave-200`): **21** S2 reports in ticket `7a76bedc00e6efc8`. Example seeds: `1900000009`, `1900000038`, `1900000084`, `1900000169`, `1900000196`. Example record: `3e6f9c51d3761f1aa858e441d8a882790579ed23935f6834acdac943436f53f9`. Repeated as a worst-moment (“the last feed still spiked cattle alarm after Aid-Only said it would not, costing two cattle”).

Fix: either apply the promised last-feed skip on the last CAST, or stop advertising that skip on the Aid-Only oath. If the skip is conditional on a successful first LAY, say so before the player commits.

evidence.summary: Grok-4.6 low MCP 200-wave ticket 7a76bedc00e6efc8 (21 S2 reports) on build 36ff6d10.
